scope: Slipstream Labor Deep Dive — schedule templates by demand tier (Downtown, Studio, 1899 Penn; NMWA for completeness)

rules.downtown: 2 open (line 6:15, lead 6:30) / 2 close to 4:30; third person by 8:00 Tue–Thu; max 4; Tue/Wed/Thu one template; 6-h minimum; lead may run 6:30–4:30
rules.studio: line person 6:15–2:30 Mon–Thu (closes the line); lead 6:30–2:30; third person 8:00–2:30 (7:00 Mon); Fri max 4, Sat/Sun max 4 slow / 5 mid-busy; two closers to 5:30; 6-h minimum
rules.1899: two shifts every day; stagger day (lead 6:30–12:30 + second 9:30–3:30) when typical sales < ~$650; anyone on at 2:00 closes at 3:30; max 2
rules.nmwa: FOH 9:00–3:00 (full hour to set up/close); 2 × FOH on community days
rules.admin: NOT in templates; scheduler's tool — 'admin helps most' notes per template

week.note: 4 × 6 h regular days; +6 h on each community day (≈ +3 h/wk averaged)

peers.who: DC minimum + tips (Ryan's rule of thumb)
peers.src: DC DOES; tips = Slipstream's own $4.50–5.60 per core hour

slipstream_now.note: Tips are applied toward the guaranteed rate (ADP: $12 tipped base + CC tips + top-up), so a team member's effective pay is the guaranteed rate; Slipstream's own tip pool is $4.50–5.60 per core hour

cost_step1.note: Step 1 = parity floors only: every Shift Lead to at least $22.50, every ALL to at least $25.50; baristas unchanged

cost_of_proposed.note: Applied to the August roster at each person's current band midpoint → proposed midpoint; everyone at $18.50 stays (trainee rate); certified $19–20.49 → $20.50; SL $20.50–22.49 → $23.50; ALL → $27.00

Dec.ryan_override: slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)
slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)
slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)

definitions.core_labor: Square timecards excluding job titles 'Manager' (admin) and 'Training'; 'Event' excluded
definitions.wage_basis: gross guaranteed wages (Square hourly_rate × hours) as % of core (ex-catering) sales — the basis of the 30/32/35 targets
definitions.pl_bridge: P&L labor ≈ 1.12 × gross wages (core+admin+training) − credit-card tips; validated Apr–Aug 2026 within 0.4–2.3% per cafe
definitions.capacity: planning capacity per cafe = busy-hour p90 throughput observed: Downtown 14, Studio 12, 1899 14 transactions per person-hour
definitions.need_rule: need(h) = max(floor, ceil(txns/h ÷ capacity)); floors — Downtown: 1 at 6:00, 2 from 6:30 to 1:00p, then 1; Studio: 1 at 6:00 (7:00 weekend), 2 to 90 min before close, then 1, Monday 3 from open to 10:00; 1899: 1 (lead) throughout, 2 in the 8–10a and 12:30–2p peaks when the curve is >= 12/hr; NMWA 1 (2 on community days)
definitions.optimizer: per cafe × tier × DOW integer program: Production Line opens (6–8 h), Shift Lead opens (8–9 h), optional Closer (4–8 h, keyholder), up to three 4–8 h barista shifts; 1899: lead 6:30–3:30 + one or two 4–8 h Production Barista shifts, max 2 on the floor; keyholder on the floor open−30 min to close+tail; minimise wages at standard rates

definitions.opt1: Open-cafe pool — DT+Studio beat share 50%, cap 1.5% of DT+Studio sales; all core hours share
definitions.opt2: Own-metric pool — Option 1 + 1899 adds $200 when NI ≥ 5% of sales + NMWA adds $100 when at/under staffing-rule hours
definitions.opt3: Template beat — 50% of Σ(template wages − actual core wages) over all cafes, cap 1.5% of all-cafe core sales
definitions.opt4: On-template + beat — $300/$300/$150/$75 per cafe-month at or under template (1% tolerance) + 50% of the beat, cap 1.5%
definitions.split: payout ÷ total core wages of all participants = bonus %; each person receives that % of own core wages

data_notes.projections_file: Projections/2026 Projections v1.8.xlsx (monthly summary identical to v1.7)
data_notes.optimizer: PuLP 3.3 / CBC; scripts ldd_10_need_v11.py, ldd_11_optimize_templates.py, ldd_12_incentive_v11.py

method.bridge: P&L labor = 1.12 × gross wages − CC tips
method.tiering: week tier from actual weekly walk-in sales scaled to a normal week (tiers.json bands); template wages per open day at planning rates
method.admin_training: added at the cafe's Apr–Aug 2026 monthly average (full-month basis)
method.tips: CC tips as the cafe's Apr–Aug 2026 average share of core sales
caveats: template rates are Aug 2026 planning rates; 2025 actual labor was paid at lower rates, so the 2025 comparison understates the template's saving
reported NOI includes catering; the core-basis rows exclude catering revenue and COGS entirely
2025 core COGS % includes catering COGS in the Consolidated Model (catering-heavy months look worse than they are)

three_cafes.note: Support entities (Commissary, SRP, Cafe Mgmt, Central) net to a monthly burden in 2026; the Consolidated Model carries no 2025 support figures, so the 12-month 'after support' view uses the 2026 Jan–Aug average × 12

cogs.note: 2026 core COGS excludes catering COGS; Jan–Aug blended for the three cafes. Gain = (blended − scenario) × 12-month core sales

headroom_12mo.note: Three cafes only (NMWA opened Jul 2026 and is excluded); core basis = core sales − COGS at the scenario % − labor − operating expenses; support = Commissary + SRP + Cafe Mgmt + Central at the 2026 Jan–Aug average

pay_scenarios_12mo.basis: reported NOI on templates (catering kept) with core COGS re-run at the scenario; three cafes; support at 2026 avg; founder salary $120K

price_lever.note: a 1% price move ≈ $11.5K/yr before any volume response (merchant fees ~3% of the increase)

pay_scenarios_12mo.note: Uplift % = each August roster member moved from their current band to the scenario rate (nobody down), hours-weighted, incl. admin/training; applied to the 12-month template wage base (core + admin/training) and loaded ×1.12. Peer all-in = DC minimum + tips as observed in postings; ALL at $27 assumes peer shift lead + $1.50.

slipstream_economics_12mo.note: Slipstream's own economics: Downtown + Studio NOI on templates (12-month backtest, catering kept, core COGS re-run) + 1899 management income ($5K + 5% of sales, 2026 average) + NMWA at its Jul–Aug 2026 run-rate (includes the $5,041/mo fee) + NMWA Nights (8 × $4,500) − Commissary, SRP, Central (2026 average × 12) − founder salary. 1899's own NOI and its template saving are excluded (passed to the owner); pay scenarios apply to Downtown + Studio only (1899 raises are the owner's cost). NMWA run-rate rests on two months.
